category_description: How income tax, GST and payroll contributions work in Canada.
subcategory_description: How federal income tax and the basic personal amount work.
label: Federal basic personal amount: maximum
context: The most that can be claimed. It applies to someone whose net income is at or below the amount where the 29% tax bracket begins.

label: Federal basic personal amount: minimum
context: The least that can be claimed. It applies to someone whose net income is at or above the amount where the 33% tax bracket begins.
The maximum basic personal amount applies at or below this net income. The 29% tax bracket begins here.
The minimum basic personal amount applies at or above this net income. The 33% tax bracket begins here.
